question: In which state is the Chithirai festival celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Chithirai festival is celebrated every year at the Meenakshi Temple in Madurai, Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is celebrated during the month of April for symbolizing the unity of saivitism and Vaishnavism.
 
• It celebrates for fifteen days.
 
• According to the Tamil calendar, Chithirai is the first month of the year.
 
• On this day Lord Vishnu comes to attend the marriage ceremony of her sister and Lord Sundreshwar, which is celebrated as Chithirai.
 
• During the Chithirai festival, many events take place.
 
• The first event that takes place in the whole celebration of the Chithirai festival is the "Kodi Yetram".
 
• In Kodi Yetram the chief priest of Meenakshi temple declares the opening of the festival by hoisting the flag on the flag post of the temple.
